env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^true 7 true true$'
stdout '^\{7\}$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/a.go
exists out/b.go
exists out/c.go
exists out/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/unionfrom

go 1.27

-- m/a.lgo --
package main

func beforeOk(u Any) bool {
	_, ok := u.(float64)
	return !ok
}

-- m/b.lgo --
package main

type Circle struct {
	R int
}

type Square struct {
	S int
}

type Text struct {
	T string
}

type Shape interface {
	Circle | Square
}

type Any interface {
	Shape | Text
}

func asAny(x any) Any {
	v, _ := x.(Any)
	return v
}

-- m/c.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func afterOk(u Any) bool {
	_, ok := u.(float64)
	return !ok
}

func main() {
	var a Any = Circle{R: 7}
	c, ok := a.(Circle)
	fmt.Println(ok, c.R, beforeOk(a), afterOk(a))
	fmt.Println(asAny(a))
}
